"""M2 tests: explainable matching, ranking, volunteer suitability, expiry and recalculation.

All data is synthetic and inserted directly so expected values are controlled.
Travel-time assumptions (road factor 1.3, 20 km/h average) are checked against
the ASSUMPTIONS list rather than re-derived here.
"""

import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from surplus_link.db import get_db, seed_db
from surplus_link.matching import (
    ASSUMPTIONS,
    ROAD_FACTOR,
    evaluate_listing,
    haversine_km,
    quantity_fit,
    reserved_kg,
    road_km,
    split_csv,
    travel_minutes,
)
from surplus_link.timeutils import set_clock
from werkzeug.datastructures import MultiDict

NOW = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 6, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)  # 11:30 IST
NOW_ISO = "2025-01-01T06:00:00+00:00"
OLD_ISO = "2024-12-22T06:00:00+00:00"  # 10 days before NOW
PICKUP = "2025-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"  # 6.5 h after NOW
PAST_PICKUP = "2025-01-01T05:00:00+00:00"
DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG = 12.9000, 77.6000
FAR_LAT = DONOR_LAT + 0.1  # about 11.1 km straight line
VERY_FAR_LAT = DONOR_LAT + 1.0  # about 111 km straight line


# ---- fixtures and helpers ----


@pytest.fixture
def fixed_clock():
    set_clock(lambda: NOW)
    yield
    set_clock(None)


@pytest.fixture
def db(app):
    with app.app_context():
        yield get_db()


def insert_org(db, name, org_type, lat, lng, cap=None, need=None, level=None,
               storage="ambient,chilled,frozen", excl=""):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO organisation (name, org_type, zone, lat, lng, weekly_intake_capacity_kg,"
        " current_need_kg, need_level, accepted_storage, allergen_exclusions)"
        " VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (name, org_type, "Zone A", lat, lng, cap, need, level, storage, excl),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_volunteer(db, name, lat, lng, cap, frm="08:00", until="20:00"):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO volunteer (name, zone, lat, lng, carrying_capacity_kg,"
        " available_from_ist, available_until_ist) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (name, "Zone A", lat, lng, cap, frm, until),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_listing(db, donor_id, qty, pickup_utc_iso, storage="chilled", allergens="",
                   status="posted"):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO listing (donor_org_id, description, quantity_kg, pickup_by_utc,"
        " storage_type, handling_notes, allergens, status, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc)"
        " VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (donor_id, "Test food", qty, pickup_utc_iso, storage, "", allergens, status,
         NOW_ISO, NOW_ISO),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_claim(db, listing_id, receiver_id, qty, status="active", claimed_at_utc=NOW_ISO):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO claim (listing_id, receiver_org_id, volunteer_id, quantity_kg, status,"
        " claimed_at_utc) VALUES (?,?,NULL,?,?,?)",
        (listing_id, receiver_id, qty, status, claimed_at_utc),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def donor_and_ngos(db):
    """Insert a synthetic donor at the standard donor coordinates and return its id."""
    return insert_org(db, "Test Donor", "donor", DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG)


def good_ngo(db, name="NGO Test", lat=DONOR_LAT, lng=DONOR_LNG, cap=500, need=50, level=2,
             storage="ambient,chilled,frozen", excl=""):
    return insert_org(db, name, "ngo", lat, lng, cap=cap, need=need, level=level,
                      storage=storage, excl=excl)


def open_listing(db, donor_id, qty=10, storage="chilled", allergens="", pickup=PICKUP,
                 status="posted"):
    return insert_listing(db, donor_id, qty, pickup, storage, allergens, status)


def _find(items, key, value):
    return next(item for item in items if item[key] == value)


def _receiver(result, org_id):
    return _find(result["receivers"], "org_id", org_id)


def _volunteer(result, volunteer_id):
    return _find(result["volunteers"], "volunteer_id", volunteer_id)


def _factor(item, name):
    return next(b for b in item["breakdown"] if b["factor"] == name)


def _has(reasons, text):
    return any(text in r for r in reasons)


def _valid_form():
    return {
        "description": "Dal and rice",
        "quantity_kg": "12.5",
        "pickup_by": "2025-01-01T15:00",
        "storage_type": "chilled",
        "handling_notes": "Keep covered",
        "allergens": ["dairy"],
    }


# ---- pure helpers ----


def test_haversine_zero_for_same_point():
    assert haversine_km(12.9, 77.6, 12.9, 77.6) == 0


def test_road_km_applies_factor():
    straight = haversine_km(DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG, 12.95, 77.65)
    assert road_km(DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG, 12.95, 77.65) == pytest.approx(straight * ROAD_FACTOR)


def test_travel_minutes():
    assert travel_minutes(20) == pytest.approx(60.0)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "qty, need, expected",
    [(10, 10, 1.0), (5, 10, 0.5), (0, 10, 0.0), (10, 0, 0.0)],
)
def test_quantity_fit(qty, need, expected):
    assert quantity_fit(qty, need) == expected

    assert split_csv(None) == []


# ---- recalculation and capacity ----


def test_reserved_kg_counts_active_and_completed_in_window(db):
    donor = donor_and_ngos(db)
    rec = good_ngo(db)
    cases = [
        ("active", 10, NOW_ISO),
        ("completed", 5, NOW_ISO),
        ("released", 7, NOW_ISO),
        ("active", 4, OLD_ISO),
    ]
    for status, qty, claimed_at in cases:
        listing = open_listing(db, donor, qty=qty, status="claimed")
        insert_claim(db, listing, rec, qty, status=status, claimed_at_utc=claimed_at)
    active, window = reserved_kg(db, rec, NOW)
    assert active == 10.0
    assert window == 15.0


def test_released_claim_frees_capacity(db):
    donor = donor_and_ngos(db)
    rec = good_ngo(db, cap=20)
    other = open_listing(db, donor, qty=15, status="claimed")
    claim = insert_claim(db, other, rec, 15)
    target = open_listing(db, donor, qty=10)

    before = _receiver(evaluate_listing(db, target, NOW), rec)
    assert not before["eligible"]
    assert _has(before["reasons"], "exceeds remaining weekly intake capacity")

    db.execute("UPDATE claim SET status='released' WHERE id=?", (claim,))
    db.commit()
    after = _receiver(evaluate_listing(db, target, NOW), rec)
    assert after["eligible"]


def test_result_reflects_current_need_not_snapshot(db):
    donor = donor_and_ngos(db)
    rec = good_ngo(db, need=50)
    listing = open_listing(db, donor)
    assert _receiver(evaluate_listing(db, listing, NOW), rec)["eligible"]

    db.execute("UPDATE organisation SET current_need_kg=0 WHERE id=?", (rec,))
    db.commit()
    result = _receiver(evaluate_listing(db, listing, NOW), rec)
    assert _has(result["reasons"], "No current food need remaining.")

# ---- receiver scoring and ranking ----


def test_score_breakdown_sums_to_score(db):
    donor = donor_and_ngos(db)
    rec = good_ngo(db)
    listing = open_listing(db, donor)
    item = _receiver(evaluate_listing(db, listing, NOW), rec)
    assert item["eligible"]
    assert sum(b["points"] for b in item["breakdown"]) == pytest.approx(item["score"], abs=0.11)
    assert [b["factor"] for b in item["breakdown"]] == [
        "Distance", "Quantity fit", "Timing slack", "Recipient need",

    assert all(b["points"] <= b["max_points"] for b in item["breakdown"])
    assert sum(b["max_points"] for b in item["breakdown"]) == pytest.approx(100)


def test_closer_receiver_scores_higher_distance_points(db):
    donor = donor_and_ngos(db)
    close = good_ngo(db, name="Close")

    listing = open_listing(db, donor)
    result = evaluate_listing(db, listing, NOW)

"""M2 tests: explainable matching, ranking, volunteer suitability, expiry and recalculation.

All data is synthetic and inserted directly so expected values are controlled.
Travel-time assumptions (road factor 1.3, 20 km/h average) are checked against
the ASSUMPTIONS list rather than re-derived here.
"""

import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from surplus_link.db import get_db, seed_db
from surplus_link.matching import (
    ASSUMPTIONS,
    ROAD_FACTOR,
    evaluate_listing,
    haversine_km,
    quantity_fit,
    reserved_kg,
    road_km,
    split_csv,
    travel_minutes,
)
from surplus_link.timeutils import set_clock
from werkzeug.datastructures import MultiDict

NOW = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 6, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)  # 11:30 IST
NOW_ISO = "2025-01-01T06:00:00+00:00"
OLD_ISO = "2024-12-22T06:00:00+00:00"  # 10 days before NOW
PICKUP = "2025-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"  # 6.5 h after NOW
PAST_PICKUP = "2025-01-01T05:00:00+00:00"
DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG = 12.9000, 77.6000
FAR_LAT = DONOR_LAT + 0.1  # about 11.1 km straight line
VERY_FAR_LAT = DONOR_LAT + 1.0  # about 111 km straight line


# ---- fixtures and helpers ----


@pytest.fixture
def fixed_clock():
    set_clock(lambda: NOW)
    yield
    set_clock(None)


@pytest.fixture
def db(app):
    with app.app_context():
        yield get_db()


def insert_org(db, name, org_type, lat, lng, cap=None, need=None, level=None,
               storage="ambient,chilled,frozen", excl=""):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO organisation (name, org_type, zone, lat, lng, weekly_intake_capacity_kg,"
        " current_need_kg, need_level, accepted_storage, allergen_exclusions)"
        " VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (name, org_type, "Zone A", lat, lng, cap, need, level, storage, excl),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_volunteer(db, name, lat, lng, cap, frm="08:00", until="20:00"):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO volunteer (name, zone, lat, lng, carrying_capacity_kg,"
        " available_from_ist, available_until_ist) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (name, "Zone A", lat, lng, cap, frm, until),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_listing(db, donor_id, qty, pickup_utc_iso, storage="chilled", allergens="",
                   status="posted"):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO listing (donor_org_id, description, quantity_kg, pickup_by_utc,"
        " storage_type, handling_notes, allergens, status, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc)"
        " VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (donor_id, "Test food", qty, pickup_utc_iso, storage, "", allergens, status,
         NOW_ISO, NOW_ISO),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_claim(db, listing_id, receiver_id, qty, status="active", claimed_at_utc=NOW_ISO):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO claim (listing_id, receiver_org_id, volunteer_id, quantity_kg, status,"
        " claimed_at_utc) VALUES (?,?,NULL,?,?,?)",
        (listing_id, receiver_id, qty, status, claimed_at_utc),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def donor_and_ngos(db):
    """Insert a synthetic donor at the standard donor coordinates and return its id."""
    return insert_org(db, "Test Donor", "donor", DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG)


def good_ngo(db, name="NGO Test", lat=DONOR_LAT, lng=DONOR_LNG, cap=500, need=50, level=2,
             storage="ambient,chilled,frozen", excl=""):
    return insert_org(db, name, "ngo", lat, lng, cap=cap, need=need, level=level,
                      storage=storage, excl=excl)


def open_listing(db, donor_id, qty=10, storage="chilled", allergens="", pickup=PICKUP,
                 status="posted"):
    return insert_listing(db, donor_id, qty, pickup, storage, allergens, status)


def _find(items, key, value):
    return next(item for item in items if item[key] == value)


def _receiver(result, org_id):
    return _find(result["receivers"], "org_id", org_id)


def _volunteer(result, volunteer_id):
    return _find(result["volunteers"], "volunteer_id", volunteer_id)


def _factor(item, name):
    return next(b for b in item["breakdown"] if b["factor"] == name)


def _has(reasons, text):
    return any(text in r for r in reasons)


def _valid_form():
    return {
        "description": "Dal and rice",
        "quantity_kg": "12.5",
        "pickup_by": "2025-01-01T15:00",

        ("active", 10, NOW_ISO),
        ("completed", 5, NOW_ISO),
        ("released", 7, NOW_ISO),
        ("active", 4, OLD_ISO),
    ]
    for status, qty, claimed_at in cases:
        listing = open_listing(db, donor, qty=qty, status="claimed")
        insert_claim(db, listing, rec, qty, status=status, claimed_at_utc=claimed_at)
    active, window = reserved_kg(db, rec, NOW)
    assert active == 10.0
    assert window == 15.0


def test_released_claim_frees_capacity(db):
    donor = donor_and_ngos(db)
    rec = good_ngo(db, cap=20)
    other = open_listing(db, donor, qty=15, status="claimed")
    claim = insert_claim(db, other, rec, 15)
    target = open_listing(db, donor, qty=10)

    before = _receiver(evaluate_listing(db, target, NOW), rec)
    assert not before["eligible"]
    assert _has(before["reasons"], "exceeds remaining weekly intake capacity")

    db.execute("UPDATE claim SET status='released' WHERE id=?", (claim,))

    after = _receiver(evaluate_listing(db, target, NOW), rec)

"""SurplusLink application factory (M0: skeleton, schema, seed, persona picker)."""

import os
from pathlib import Path

import click
from flask import Flask

from . import db, timeutils, views
from .donations import donations_bp
from .matching import matching_bp

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEV_SECRET_KEY = "dev-only-insecure-key"


def create_app(test_config=None):
    test_config = test_config or {}
    app = Flask(__name__)

    env_secret = os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY")
    if "SECRET_KEY" in test_config:
        secret = test_config["SECRET_KEY"]
    elif env_secret:
        secret = env_secret
    elif os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_ENV") == "production":
        raise RuntimeError("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY must be set when SURPLUSLINK_ENV=production")
    else:
        secret = DEV_SECRET_KEY

    default_db = PROJECT_ROOT / "instance" / "surpluslink.db"
    app.config.from_mapping(
        SECRET_KEY=secret,
        DATABASE=os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_DB_PATH", str(default_db)),
    )
    app.config.from_mapping(test_config)

    app.teardown_appcontext(db.close_db)
    app.register_blueprint(views.bp)
    app.register_blueprint(donations_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(matching_bp)
    app.add_template_filter(timeutils.format_ist, "ist")

    @app.cli.command("init-db")
    def init_db_command():
        """Create the database tables if they do not exist. Keeps existing data."""
        db.init_db()

import os, re, sqlite3, json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5006"
SHOT = os.path.join(os.environ["TEMP"], "surplus_matches_375.png")
DB = os.environ["SURPLUSLINK_DB_PATH"]
out = {}
console_errors, failed = [], []

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    ctx = b.new_context(viewport={"width": 375, "height": 812}, device_scale_factor=2)
    pg = ctx.new_page()
    pg.on("console", lambda m: console_errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)
    pg.on("requestfailed", lambda r: failed.append(f"{r.method} {r.url} {r.failure}"))
    pg.on("response", lambda r: failed.append(f"HTTP {r.status} {r.url}") if r.status >= 400 else None)

    # a. persona + post listing
    pg.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="load")
    pg.get_by_text("Mess Donor 1 (Synthetic)", exact=True).first.click()
    pg.wait_for_load_state("load")
    pg.goto(BASE + "/donate", wait_until="load")
    pg.fill("#description", "Test dal rice")
    pg.fill("#quantity_kg", "12.5")
    pg.fill("#pickup_by", "2030-01-01T15:00")
    pg.select_option("#storage_type", "chilled")
    pg.fill("#handling_notes", "Keep covered")
    pg.check("input[name=allergens][value=dairy]")
    pg.get_by_role("button", name="Post surplus").click()
    pg.wait_for_load_state("load")
    out["a_url"] = pg.url
    m = re.search(r"/listings/(\d+)", pg.url)
    listing_id = m.group(1) if m else None
    out["listing_id"] = listing_id

    # b. link on listing page
    link = pg.get_by_role("link", name="See ranked matches")
    out["b_link_count"] = link.count()
    out["b_href"] = link.first.get_attribute("href") if link.count() else None

    # c. matches page
    resp = pg.goto(BASE + (out["b_href"] or f"/listings/{listing_id}/matches"), wait_until="load")
    out["c_status"] = resp.status
    body = pg.content()
    out["c_has_ranked"] = "Ranked matches" in body
    out["c_has_assumptions"] = "Assumptions" in body
    out["c_li_match"] = pg.locator("li.match").count()

    # d. horizontal scroll and wide elements
    out["d_scrollWidth"] = pg.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
    out["d_innerWidth"] = pg.evaluate("window.innerWidth")
    out["d_wide"] = pg.evaluate("""() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *'))
        .filter(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().right > 375.5)
        .slice(0, 10).map(e => e.tagName + '.' + (e.className || '') + ' right=' + Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().right))""")

    # e. first eligible and first ineligible card
    cards = pg.locator("li.match")
    first_el = None; first_inel = None
    for i in range(cards.count()):
        t = cards.nth(i).inner_text()
        if "Eligible" in t and "Not eligible" not in t and first_el is None:
            first_el = t
        if "Not eligible" in t and first_inel is None:
            first_inel = t
    out["e_first_eligible"] = first_el
    out["e_first_ineligible"] = first_inel

    # f. screenshot
    pg.screenshot(path=SHOT, full_page=True)
    out["f_screenshot"] = SHOT

    # h. expired listing
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    cur = con.execute(
        "INSERT INTO listing (donor_org_id, description, quantity_kg, pickup_by_utc, storage_type, "
        "handling_notes, allergens, status, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc) "
        "VALUES (1, 'Expired check', 5.0, '2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00', 'ambient', '', '', 'posted', ?, ?)",
        (now, now))
    con.commit()
    exp_id = cur.lastrowid
    con.close()
    out["h_expired_id"] = exp_id
    pg.goto(f"{BASE}/listings/{exp_id}/matches", wait_until="load")
    out["h_deadline_msg"] = "Pickup-by deadline has passed." in pg.content()

    # i. no-match check on the test listing
    pg.goto(f"{BASE}/listings/{listing_id}/matches", wait_until="load")
    c2 = pg.content()
    out["i_no_suitable_receivers"] = "No suitable receivers" in c2
    out["i_eligible_cards"] = pg.evaluate("""() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li.match'))
        .filter(li => li.innerText.includes('Eligible') && !li.innerText.includes('Not eligible')).length""")
    b.close()

out["g_console_errors"] = console_errors
out["g_failed_requests"] = failed
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

"""SurplusLink application factory (M0: skeleton, schema, seed, persona picker)."""

import os
from pathlib import Path

import click
from flask import Flask

from . import db, timeutils, views
from .donations import donations_bp
from .matching import matching_bp

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEV_SECRET_KEY = "dev-only-insecure-key"


def create_app(test_config=None):
    test_config = test_config or {}
    app = Flask(__name__)

    env_secret = os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY")
    if "SECRET_KEY" in test_config:
        secret = test_config["SECRET_KEY"]
    elif env_secret:
        secret = env_secret
    elif os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_ENV") == "production":
        raise RuntimeError("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY must be set when SURPLUSLINK_ENV=production")
    else:
        secret = DEV_SECRET_KEY

    default_db = PROJECT_ROOT / "instance" / "surpluslink.db"
    app.config.from_mapping(
        SECRET_KEY=secret,
        DATABASE=os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_DB_PATH", str(default_db)),
    )
    app.config.from_mapping(test_config)

    app.teardown_appcontext(db.close_db)
    app.register_blueprint(views.bp)
    app.register_blueprint(donations_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(matching_bp)
    app.add_template_filter(timeutils.format_ist, "ist")

    @app.cli.command("init-db")
    def init_db_command():
        """Create the database tables if they do not exist. Keeps existing data."""
        db.init_db()
        click.echo(f"Database ready at {app.config['DATABASE']}")

    @app.cli.command("seed")
    @click.option("--reset", is_flag=True, help="Delete synthetic rows only, then seed again.")
    def seed_command(reset):
        """Insert synthetic demo data (idempotent unless --reset)."""
        db.init_db()
        result = db.seed_db(reset=reset)
        click.echo(result["message"])
        click.echo(
            f"donor orgs={result['donor_orgs']} ngo orgs={result['ngo_orgs']} "
            f"volunteers={result['volunteers']} personas={result['personas']} "
            f"listings={result['listings']}"
        )

    return app

def create_app(test_config=None):
    test_config = test_config or {}
    app = Flask(__name__)

    env_secret = os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY")
    if "SECRET_KEY" in test_config:
        secret = test_config["SECRET_KEY"]
    elif env_secret:
        secret = env_secret
    elif os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_ENV") == "production":
        raise RuntimeError("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY must be set when SURPLUSLINK_ENV=production")
    else:
        secret = DEV_SECRET_KEY

    default_db = PROJECT_ROOT / "instance" / "surpluslink.db"
    app.config.from_mapping(
        SECRET_KEY=secret,
        DATABASE=os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_DB_PATH", str(default_db)),
    )
    app.config.from_mapping(test_config)

    app.teardown_appcontext(db.close_db)
    app.register_blueprint(views.bp)
    app.register_blueprint(donations_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(matching_bp)
    app.add_template_filter(timeutils.format_ist, "ist")

    @app.cli.command("init-db")
    def init_db_command():
        """Create the database tables if they do not exist. Keeps existing data."""
        db.init_db()
        click.echo(f"Database ready at {app.config['DATABASE']}")

        )

"""Explainable matching for SurplusLink (M2).

Ranks receiver organisations and volunteers for a posted listing and explains
every score and every ineligibility reason. Nothing is cached: each call
recalculates eligibility from the current database rows.

Travel times are planning estimates (straight-line distance x road factor at
an assumed average speed), not measured routes. Coordinates are synthetic.
This module does not claim listings and does not change listing status.
"""

import math
import re
from datetime import timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from flask import Blueprint, abort, render_template

from .db import get_db
from .timeutils import now_utc, parse_utc, to_utc_iso

ROAD_FACTOR = 1.3
AVERAGE_SPEED_KMH = 20.0
PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN = 15
MAX_DISTANCE_KM = 15.0
TIMING_CAP_MIN = 120
CAPACITY_WINDOW_DAYS = 7

RECEIVER_WEIGHTS = {"distance": 35, "quantity": 25, "timing": 20, "need": 20}
VOLUNTEER_WEIGHTS = {"distance": 40, "capacity": 30, "timing": 30}

ASSUMPTIONS = [
    "Travel time: straight-line distance x 1.3 road factor at an assumed "
    "average of 20 km/h. Planning estimate, not measured.",
    "Pickup buffer: 15 minutes are reserved at the end of travel before the "
    "pickup-by deadline.",
    "Volunteer travel period must fit the same 15-minute pickup buffer as receivers.",
    "Distance score: full points at 0 km, zero points at 15 km or more.",
    "Timing slack: slack is capped at 120 minutes when scoring.",
    "Weekly intake: all active claims count as outstanding commitments "
    "regardless of age; completed claims count only if claimed in the last "
    "7 days; released claims never count; each claim counts once.",
    "Coordinates are synthetic.",
    "Need level 3 is the highest need.",
    "A volunteer without a recorded availability window is treated as "
    "unavailable.",
]

IST = ZoneInfo("Asia/Kolkata")

matching_bp = Blueprint("matching", __name__)


def haversine_km(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2):
    """Great-circle distance in km on a sphere of radius 6371 km."""
    radius_km = 6371.0
    phi1 = math.radians(lat1)
    phi2 = math.radians(lat2)
    d_phi = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    d_lambda = math.radians(lng2 - lng1)
    a = (
        math.sin(d_phi / 2) ** 2
        + math.cos(phi1) * math.cos(phi2) * math.sin(d_lambda / 2) ** 2
    )
    return 2 * radius_km * math.asin(min(1.0, math.sqrt(a)))


def road_km(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2):
    """Approximate road distance: straight-line distance x ROAD_FACTOR."""
    return haversine_km(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) * ROAD_FACTOR


def travel_minutes(km):
    """Estimated travel time in minutes at AVERAGE_SPEED_KMH."""
    return km / AVERAGE_SPEED_KMH * 60.0


def quantity_fit(quantity, need):
    """Ratio of smaller to larger value, in [0, 1]. 0.0 if either is <= 0."""
    if quantity <= 0 or need <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return min(quantity, need) / max(quantity, need)


def split_csv(text):
    """Split a comma list into stripped, non-empty items. None gives []."""
    if not text:
        return []
    return [part.strip() for part in text.split(",") if part.strip()]


def parse_hhmm(text):
    """Return minutes since midnight for 'HH:MM', or None if not parseable."""
    if not text:
        return None
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*", text)
    if not match:
        return None
    hours, minutes = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2))
    if hours > 23 or minutes > 59:
        return None
    return hours * 60 + minutes


def reserved_kg(db, receiver_org_id, now):
    """Return (active_kg, completed_window_kg) for a receiver.

    active_kg: total quantity of the receiver's active claims, regardless of
    how old they are, so outstanding commitments never drop out of capacity.
    completed_window_kg: total quantity of completed claims claimed within the
    last CAPACITY_WINDOW_DAYS. Released claims never count. Each claim is
    counted once.
    """
    active_row = db.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_kg), 0) AS total FROM claim "
        "WHERE receiver_org_id = ? AND status = 'active'",
        (receiver_org_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    active_kg = float(active_row["total"] or 0.0)

    window_start = now - timedelta(days=CAPACITY_WINDOW_DAYS)
    rows = db.execute(
        "SELECT quantity_kg, claimed_at_utc FROM claim "
        "WHERE receiver_org_id = ? AND status = 'completed'",
        (receiver_org_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    completed_window_kg = 0.0
    for row in rows:
        if parse_utc(row["claimed_at_utc"]) >= window_start:
            completed_window_kg += float(row["quantity_kg"] or 0.0)
    return active_kg, completed_window_kg


def _breakdown_item(label, value, raw_points, weight):
    return {
        "factor": label,
        "value": value,
        "points": round(raw_points, 1),
        "max_points": weight,
    }


def _rank(entries, id_key):
    """Eligible first (score desc, distance asc, id asc); then ineligible by name."""
    eligible = [e for e in entries if e["eligible"]]
    ineligible = [e for e in entries if not e["eligible"]]
    eligible.sort(key=lambda e: (-e["score"], e["distance_km"], e[id_key]))
    ineligible.sort(key=lambda e: e["name"] or "")
    return eligible + ineligible


def _evaluate_receiver(db, listing, donor, org, now, minutes_left):
    quantity = float(listing["quantity_kg"] or 0.0)
    storage_type = listing["storage_type"]
    listing_allergens = split_csv(listing["allergens"])

    active_kg, completed_window_kg = reserved_kg(db, org["id"], now)
    outstanding = active_kg + completed_window_kg
    capacity = float(org["weekly_intake_capacity_kg"] or 0.0)
    need = float(org["current_need_kg"] or 0.0)
    remaining_capacity = max(0.0, capacity - outstanding)
    remaining_need = max(0.0, need - active_kg)

    distance = road_km(
        donor["lat"], donor["lng"], org["lat"], org["lng"]
    )
    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
    slack = minutes_left - travel - PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN

    reasons = []
    if storage_type not in split_csv(org["accepted_storage"]):
        reasons.append(f"Does not accept {storage_type} storage.")
    excluded = sorted(
        set(listing_allergens) & set(split_csv(org["allergen_exclusions"]))
    )
    if excluded:
        reasons.append(
            "Listing contains allergen(s) this organisation excludes: "
            + ", ".join(excluded)
            + "."
        )
    if quantity > remaining_capacity:
        reasons.append(
            f"Quantity {quantity:g} kg exceeds remaining weekly intake "
            f"capacity {remaining_capacity:g} kg."
        )
    if remaining_need <= 0:
        reasons.append("No current food need remaining.")
    if slack < 0:
        reasons.append(
            f"Cannot arrive before pickup-by: about {travel:.0f} min travel "
            f"plus {PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN} min buffer exceeds the "
            f"{minutes_left:.0f} min left."
        )

    entry = {
        "org_id": org["id"],
        "name": org["name"],
        "eligible": not reasons,
        "score": None,
        "distance_km": round(distance, 1),
        "travel_min": round(travel, 1),
        "breakdown": [],
        "reasons": reasons,
        "remaining_capacity_kg": round(remaining_capacity, 1),
        "remaining_need_kg": round(remaining_need, 1),
    }
    if reasons:
        return entry

    w = RECEIVER_WEIGHTS
    need_level = int(org["need_level"] or 0)
    raw_distance = w["distance"] * max(0.0, 1 - distance / MAX_DISTANCE_KM)
    raw_quantity = w["quantity"] * quantity_fit(quantity, remaining_need)
    raw_timing = w["timing"] * min(slack, TIMING_CAP_MIN) / TIMING_CAP_MIN
    raw_need = w["need"] * need_level / 3

    breakdown = [
        _breakdown_item(
            "Distance",
            f"{distance:.1f} km (approx. road)",
            raw_distance,
            w["distance"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Quantity fit",
            f"{quantity:g} kg vs {remaining_need:g} kg remaining need",
            raw_quantity,
            w["quantity"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Timing slack",
            f"{slack:.0f} min slack after travel and buffer",
            raw_timing,
            w["timing"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Recipient need",
            f"Need level {need_level} of 3",
            raw_need,
            w["need"],
        ),
    ]
    entry["breakdown"] = breakdown
    entry["score"] = round(
        raw_distance + raw_quantity + raw_timing + raw_need, 1
    )
    return entry


def _evaluate_volunteer(volunteer, listing, donor, now, pickup, minutes_left):
    quantity = float(listing["quantity_kg"] or 0.0)
    capacity = float(volunteer["carrying_capacity_kg"] or 0.0)

    distance = road_km(
        donor["lat"], donor["lng"], volunteer["lat"], volunteer["lng"]
    )
    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
    collection = now + timedelta(minutes=travel)
    collection_end = collection + timedelta(minutes=PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN)
    collection_hhmm = collection.astimezone(IST).strftime("%H:%M")
    now_ist = now.astimezone(IST)
    start_hhmm = now_ist.strftime("%H:%M")
    start_minutes = now_ist.hour * 60 + now_ist.minute
    end_ist = collection_end.astimezone(IST)
    end_hhmm = end_ist.strftime("%H:%M")
    end_minutes = end_ist.hour * 60 + end_ist.minute
    slack = (pickup - collection_end).total_seconds() / 60.0

    reasons = []
    if quantity > capacity:
        reasons.append(
            f"Carrying capacity {capacity:g} kg is below {quantity:g} kg."
        )

    from_text = volunteer["available_from_ist"]
    until_text = volunteer["available_until_ist"]
    from_min = parse_hhmm(from_text)
    until_min = parse_hhmm(until_text)
    if from_min is None or until_min is None:
        reasons.append("Availability window not recorded.")
    elif not (from_min <= start_minutes and end_minutes <= until_min):
        reasons.append(
            "Not available for the planned travel and collection period "
            f"{start_hhmm}-{end_hhmm} IST "
            f"(window {from_text.strip()}-{until_text.strip()} IST)."
        )

    if slack < 0:
        reasons.append(
            f"Cannot reach the donor before pickup-by (about {travel:.0f} min "
            "travel)."
        )

    entry = {
        "volunteer_id": volunteer["id"],
        "name": volunteer["name"],
        "eligible": not reasons,
        "score": None,
        "distance_km": round(distance, 1),
        "travel_min": round(travel, 1),
        "collection_time_ist": collection_hhmm,
        "breakdown": [],
        "reasons": reasons,
    }
    if reasons:
        return entry

    w = VOLUNTEER_WEIGHTS
    capacity_ratio = min(1.0, quantity / capacity) if capacity > 0 else 0.0
    raw_distance = w["distance"] * max(0.0, 1 - distance / MAX_DISTANCE_KM)
    raw_capacity = w["capacity"] * capacity_ratio
    raw_timing = w["timing"] * min(slack, TIMING_CAP_MIN) / TIMING_CAP_MIN

    entry["breakdown"] = [
        _breakdown_item(
            "Distance",
            f"{distance:.1f} km to donor (approx. road)",
            raw_distance,
            w["distance"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Capacity use",
            f"{quantity:g} of {capacity:g} kg carrying capacity",
            raw_capacity,
            w["capacity"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Timing slack",
            f"{slack:.0f} min before pickup-by at collection",
            raw_timing,
            w["timing"],
        ),
    ]
    entry["score"] = round(raw_distance + raw_capacity + raw_timing, 1)
    return entry


def evaluate_listing(db, listing_id, now):
    """Evaluate every NGO and volunteer against one listing.

    Returns None if the listing does not exist. Otherwise returns a dict with
    listing_id, listing_open, listing_reason, receivers, volunteers and
    assumptions. Receivers and volunteers are empty when the listing is not
    open for matching.
    """
    listing = db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM listing WHERE id = ?", (listing_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if listing is None:
        return None

    pickup = parse_utc(listing["pickup_by_utc"])
    minutes_left = (pickup - now).total_seconds() / 60.0

    listing_open = True
    listing_reason = None
    if listing["status"] != "posted":
        listing_open = False
        listing_reason = (
            f"Listing is {listing['status']}, not open for matching."
        )
    elif pickup <= now:
        listing_open = False
        listing_reason = "Pickup-by deadline has passed."

    result = {
        "listing_id": listing_id,
        "listing_open": listing_open,
        "listing_reason": listing_reason,
        "receivers": [],
        "volunteers": [],
        "assumptions": list(ASSUMPTIONS),
    }
    if not listing_open:
        return result

    donor = db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM organisation WHERE id = ?",
        (listing["donor_org_id"],),
    ).fetchone()

    receivers = []
    for org in db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM organisation WHERE org_type = 'ngo' ORDER BY id"
    ).fetchall():
        receivers.append(
            _evaluate_receiver(db, listing, donor, org, now, minutes_left)
        )

    volunteers = []
    for volunteer in db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM volunteer ORDER BY id"
    ).fetchall():
        volunteers.append(
            _evaluate_volunteer(
                volunteer, listing, donor, now, pickup, minutes_left
            )
        )

    result["receivers"] = _rank(receivers, "org_id")
    result["volunteers"] = _rank(volunteers, "volunteer_id")
    return result


@matching_bp.route("/listings/<int:listing_id>/matches")
def listing_matches(listing_id):
    db = get_db()
    result = evaluate_listing(db, listing_id, now_utc())
    if result is None:
        abort(404)
    listing = db.execute(
        "SELECT l.*, o.name AS donor_name FROM listing l "
        "JOIN organisation o ON o.id = l.donor_org_id WHERE l.id = ?",
        (listing_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    return render_template("matches.html", result=result, listing=listing)

"""SurplusLink application factory (M0: skeleton, schema, seed, persona picker)."""

import os
from pathlib import Path

import click
from flask import Flask

from . import db, timeutils, views
from .donations import donations_bp
from .matching import matching_bp

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEV_SECRET_KEY = "dev-only-insecure-key"


def create_app(test_config=None):
    test_config = test_config or {}
    app = Flask(__name__)

    env_secret = os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY")
    if "SECRET_KEY" in test_config:
        secret = test_config["SECRET_KEY"]
    elif env_secret:
        secret = env_secret
    elif os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_ENV") == "production":
        raise RuntimeError("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY must be set when SURPLUSLINK_ENV=production")
    else:
        secret = DEV_SECRET_KEY

    default_db = PROJECT_ROOT / "instance" / "surpluslink.db"
    app.config.from_mapping(
        SECRET_KEY=secret,
        DATABASE=os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_DB_PATH", str(default_db)),
    )
    app.config.from_mapping(test_config)

    app.teardown_appcontext(db.close_db)
    app.register_blueprint(views.bp)
    app.register_blueprint(donations_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(matching_bp)
    app.add_template_filter(timeutils.format_ist, "ist")

    @app.cli.command("init-db")
    def init_db_command():
        """Create the database tables if they do not exist. Keeps existing data."""
        db.init_db()
        click.echo(f"Database ready at {app.config['DATABASE']}")

    @app.cli.command("seed")
    @click.option("--reset", is_flag=True, help="Delete synthetic rows only, then seed again.")
    def seed_command(reset):
        """Insert synthetic demo data (idempotent unless --reset)."""
        db.init_db()
        result = db.seed_db(reset=reset)
        click.echo(result["message"])
        click.echo(
            f"donor orgs={result['donor_orgs']} ngo orgs={result['ngo_orgs']} "
            f"volunteers={result['volunteers']} personas={result['personas']} "
            f"listings={result['listings']}"
        )

    return app

"""M1 donation form: validation, persistence, donor-only posting, detail page."""

import math
import zoneinfo
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from flask import Blueprint, abort, redirect, render_template, request, url_for
from werkzeug.datastructures import MultiDict

from . import timeutils
from .db import get_db
from .views import current_persona

donations_bp = Blueprint("donations", __name__)

STORAGE_TYPES = ("ambient", "chilled", "frozen")
STORAGE_LABELS = {
    "ambient": "Ambient (dry goods, room temperature)",
    "chilled": "Chilled (refrigerated)",
    "frozen": "Frozen",
}
ALLERGENS = ("gluten", "dairy", "eggs", "nuts", "soy", "fish", "shellfish", "sesame")
MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN = 200
MAX_NOTES_LEN = 500
MIN_QUANTITY_KG = 0.1
MAX_QUANTITY_KG = 1000.0
DEADLINE_FORMAT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M"
IST = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("Asia/Kolkata")

QUANTITY_MESSAGE = f"Enter a quantity between {MIN_QUANTITY_KG:g} and {MAX_QUANTITY_KG:g} kg."


def validate_listing_form(form, now):
    """Validate submitted listing fields. Returns (cleaned, errors)."""
    cleaned = {}
    errors = {}

    description = form.get("description", "").strip()
    if not description:
        errors["description"] = "Enter a description of the food."
    elif len(description) > MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN:
        errors["description"] = f"Description must be {MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN} characters or fewer."
    cleaned["description"] = description

    raw_quantity = form.get("quantity_kg", "").strip()
    quantity = None
    if not raw_quantity:
        errors["quantity_kg"] = QUANTITY_MESSAGE
    else:
        try:
            quantity = float(raw_quantity)
        except ValueError:
            quantity = None
        if quantity is None or not math.isfinite(quantity) or not (
            MIN_QUANTITY_KG <= quantity <= MAX_QUANTITY_KG
        ):
            errors["quantity_kg"] = QUANTITY_MESSAGE
    cleaned["quantity_kg"] = quantity

    raw_deadline = form.get("pickup_by", "").strip()
    cleaned["pickup_by_utc"] = None
    if not raw_deadline:
        errors["pickup_by"] = "Enter the pickup-by deadline."
    else:
        try:
            local = datetime.strptime(raw_deadline, DEADLINE_FORMAT).replace(tzinfo=IST)
        except ValueError:
            errors["pickup_by"] = "Enter a valid pickup-by date and time."
        else:
            if local <= now:
                errors["pickup_by"] = "Pickup-by must be in the future."
            else:
                cleaned["pickup_by_utc"] = timeutils.to_utc_iso(local)

    storage_type = form.get("storage_type", "").strip()
    if storage_type not in STORAGE_TYPES:
        errors["storage_type"] = "Choose a storage type."
    cleaned["storage_type"] = storage_type

    handling_notes = form.get("handling_notes", "").strip()
    if len(handling_notes) > MAX_NOTES_LEN:
        errors["handling_notes"] = f"Handling information must be {MAX_NOTES_LEN} characters or fewer."
    cleaned["handling_notes"] = handling_notes

    submitted = form.getlist("allergens")
    if any(a not in ALLERGENS for a in submitted):
        errors["allergens"] = "Choose allergens from the list."
    cleaned["allergens"] = ",".join(a for a in ALLERGENS if a in submitted)

    return cleaned, errors


def create_listing(db, donor_org_id, persona_id, cleaned, now):
    """Insert a posted listing and its first status event in one transaction."""
    stamp = timeutils.to_utc_iso(now)
    try:
        cursor = db.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO listing (donor_org_id, description, quantity_kg, pickup_by_utc,
                                 storage_type, handling_notes, allergens, status,
                                 created_at_utc, updated_at_utc)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'posted', ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                donor_org_id,
                cleaned["description"],
                cleaned["quantity_kg"],
                cleaned["pickup_by_utc"],
                cleaned["storage_type"],
                cleaned["handling_notes"],
                cleaned["allergens"],
                stamp,
                stamp,
            ),
        )
        listing_id = cursor.lastrowid
        db.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO status_event (listing_id, from_status, to_status, actor_persona_id, at_utc)
            VALUES (?, NULL, 'posted', ?, ?)
            """,
            (listing_id, persona_id, stamp),
        )
        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    return listing_id


def get_listing(db, listing_id):
    """Return the listing row joined with its donor organisation name, or None."""
    return db.execute(
        """
        SELECT l.*, o.name AS donor_name
        FROM listing l
        JOIN organisation o ON o.id = l.donor_org_id
        WHERE l.id = ?
        """,
        (listing_id,),
    ).fetchone()


def _require_donor():
    """Return (persona, None) for a donor; otherwise (None, response) or abort(403)."""
    persona = current_persona()
    if persona is None:
        return None, redirect(url_for("main.home"))
    if persona["role"] != "donor":
        abort(403)
    return persona, None


def _render_form(values, errors, status):
    return (
        render_template(
            "donate.html",
            values=values,
            errors=errors,
            storage_options=[(key, STORAGE_LABELS[key]) for key in STORAGE_TYPES],
            allergen_options=ALLERGENS,
        ),
        status,
    )


@donations_bp.route("/donate", methods=["GET", "POST"])
def new_listing():
    persona, response = _require_donor()
    if response is not None:
        return response

    if request.method == "GET":
        return _render_form(MultiDict(), {}, 200)

    now = timeutils.now_utc()
    cleaned, errors = validate_listing_form(request.form, now)
    if errors:
        return _render_form(request.form, errors, 400)

    db = get_db()
    row = db.execute("SELECT organisation_id FROM persona WHERE id = ?", (persona["id"],)).fetchone()
    listing_id = create_listing(db, row["organisation_id"], persona["id"], cleaned, now)
    return redirect(url_for("donations.listing_detail", listing_id=listing_id, created=1), code=303)


@donations_bp.route("/listings/<int:listing_id>")
def listing_detail(listing_id):
    listing = get_listing(get_db(), listing_id)
    if listing is None:
        abort(404)
    allergen_list = [a for a in (listing["allergens"] or "").split(",") if a]
    return render_template(
        "listing.html",
        listing=listing,
        allergen_list=allergen_list,
        show_created=request.args.get("created") == "1",
    )

"""Explainable matching for SurplusLink (M2).

Ranks receiver organisations and volunteers for a posted listing and explains
every score and every ineligibility reason. Nothing is cached: each call
recalculates eligibility from the current database rows.

Travel times are planning estimates (straight-line distance x road factor at
an assumed average speed), not measured routes. Coordinates are synthetic.
This module does not claim listings and does not change listing status.
"""

import math
import re
from datetime import timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from flask import Blueprint, abort, render_template

from .db import get_db
from .timeutils import now_utc, parse_utc, to_utc_iso

ROAD_FACTOR = 1.3
AVERAGE_SPEED_KMH = 20.0
PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN = 15
MAX_DISTANCE_KM = 15.0
TIMING_CAP_MIN = 120
CAPACITY_WINDOW_DAYS = 7

RECEIVER_WEIGHTS = {"distance": 35, "quantity": 25, "timing": 20, "need": 20}
VOLUNTEER_WEIGHTS = {"distance": 40, "capacity": 30, "timing": 30}

ASSUMPTIONS = [
    "Travel time: straight-line distance x 1.3 road factor at an assumed "
    "average of 20 km/h. Planning estimate, not measured.",
    "Pickup buffer: 15 minutes are reserved at the end of travel before the "
    "pickup-by deadline.",
    "Volunteer travel period must fit the same 15-minute pickup buffer as receivers.",
    "Distance score: full points at 0 km, zero points at 15 km or more.",
    "Timing slack: slack is capped at 120 minutes when scoring.",
    "Weekly intake: all active claims count as outstanding commitments "
    "regardless of age; completed claims count only if claimed in the last "
    "7 days; released claims never count; each claim counts once.",
    "Coordinates are synthetic.",
    "Need level 3 is the highest need.",
    "A volunteer without a recorded availability window is treated as "
    "unavailable.",
]

IST = ZoneInfo("Asia/Kolkata")

matching_bp = Blueprint("matching", __name__)


def haversine_km(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2):
    """Great-circle distance in km on a sphere of radius 6371 km."""
    radius_km = 6371.0
    phi1 = math.radians(lat1)
    phi2 = math.radians(lat2)
    d_phi = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    d_lambda = math.radians(lng2 - lng1)
    a = (
        math.sin(d_phi / 2) ** 2
        + math.cos(phi1) * math.cos(phi2) * math.sin(d_lambda / 2) ** 2
    )
    return 2 * radius_km * math.asin(min(1.0, math.sqrt(a)))


def road_km(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2):
    """Approximate road distance: straight-line distance x ROAD_FACTOR."""
    return haversine_km(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) * ROAD_FACTOR


def travel_minutes(km):
    """Estimated travel time in minutes at AVERAGE_SPEED_KMH."""
    return km / AVERAGE_SPEED_KMH * 60.0


def quantity_fit(quantity, need):
    """Ratio of smaller to larger value, in [0, 1]. 0.0 if either is <= 0."""
    if quantity <= 0 or need <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return min(quantity, need) / max(quantity, need)


def split_csv(text):
    """Split a comma list into stripped, non-empty items. None gives []."""
    if not text:
        return []
    return [part.strip() for part in text.split(",") if part.strip()]


def parse_hhmm(text):
    """Return minutes since midnight for 'HH:MM', or None if not parseable."""
    if not text:
        return None
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*", text)
    if not match:
        return None
    hours, minutes = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2))
    if hours > 23 or minutes > 59:
        return None
    return hours * 60 + minutes


def reserved_kg(db, receiver_org_id, now):
    """Return (active_kg, completed_window_kg) for a receiver.

    active_kg: total quantity of the receiver's active claims, regardless of
    how old they are, so outstanding commitments never drop out of capacity.
    completed_window_kg: total quantity of completed claims claimed within the
    last CAPACITY_WINDOW_DAYS. Released claims never count. Each claim is
    counted once.
    """
    active_row = db.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_kg), 0) AS total FROM claim "
        "WHERE receiver_org_id = ? AND status = 'active'",
        (receiver_org_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    active_kg = float(active_row["total"] or 0.0)

    window_start = now - timedelta(days=CAPACITY_WINDOW_DAYS)
    rows = db.execute(
        "SELECT quantity_kg, claimed_at_utc FROM claim "
        "WHERE receiver_org_id = ? AND status = 'completed'",
        (receiver_org_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    completed_window_kg = 0.0
    for row in rows:
        if parse_utc(row["claimed_at_utc"]) >= window_start:
            completed_window_kg += float(row["quantity_kg"] or 0.0)
    return active_kg, completed_window_kg


def _breakdown_item(label, value, raw_points, weight):
    return {
        "factor": label,
        "value": value,
        "points": round(raw_points, 1),
        "max_points": weight,
    }


def _rank(entries, id_key):
    """Eligible first (score desc, distance asc, id asc); then ineligible by name."""
    eligible = [e for e in entries if e["eligible"]]
    ineligible = [e for e in entries if not e["eligible"]]
    eligible.sort(key=lambda e: (-e["score"], e["distance_km"], e[id_key]))
    ineligible.sort(key=lambda e: e["name"] or "")
    return eligible + ineligible


def _evaluate_receiver(db, listing, donor, org, now, minutes_left):
    quantity = float(listing["quantity_kg"] or 0.0)
    storage_type = listing["storage_type"]
    listing_allergens = split_csv(listing["allergens"])

    active_kg, completed_window_kg = reserved_kg(db, org["id"], now)
    outstanding = active_kg + completed_window_kg
    capacity = float(org["weekly_intake_capacity_kg"] or 0.0)
    need = float(org["current_need_kg"] or 0.0)
    remaining_capacity = max(0.0, capacity - outstanding)
    remaining_need = max(0.0, need - active_kg)

    distance = road_km(
        donor["lat"], donor["lng"], org["lat"], org["lng"]
    )
    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
    slack = minutes_left - travel - PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN

    reasons = []
    if storage_type not in split_csv(org["accepted_storage"]):
        reasons.append(f"Does not accept {storage_type} storage.")
    excluded = sorted(
        set(listing_allergens) & set(split_csv(org["allergen_exclusions"]))
    )
    if excluded:
        reasons.append(
            "Listing contains allergen(s) this organisation excludes: "
            + ", ".join(excluded)
            + "."
        )
    if quantity > remaining_capacity:
        reasons.append(
            f"Quantity {quantity:g} kg exceeds remaining weekly intake "
            f"capacity {remaining_capacity:g} kg."
        )
    if remaining_need <= 0:
        reasons.append("No current food need remaining.")
    if slack < 0:
        reasons.append(
            f"Cannot arrive before pickup-by: about {travel:.0f} min travel "
            f"plus {PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN} min buffer exceeds the "
            f"{minutes_left:.0f} min left."
        )

    entry = {
        "org_id": org["id"],
        "name": org["name"],
        "eligible": not reasons,
        "score": None,
        "distance_km": round(distance, 1),
        "travel_min": round(travel, 1),
        "breakdown": [],
        "reasons": reasons,
        "remaining_capacity_kg": round(remaining_capacity, 1),
        "remaining_need_kg": round(remaining_need, 1),
    }
    if reasons:
        return entry

    w = RECEIVER_WEIGHTS
    need_level = int(org["need_level"] or 0)
    raw_distance = w["distance"] * max(0.0, 1 - distance / MAX_DISTANCE_KM)
    raw_quantity = w["quantity"] * quantity_fit(quantity, remaining_need)
    raw_timing = w["timing"] * min(slack, TIMING_CAP_MIN) / TIMING_CAP_MIN
    raw_need = w["need"] * need_level / 3

    breakdown = [
        _breakdown_item(
            "Distance",
            f"{distance:.1f} km (approx. road)",
            raw_distance,
            w["distance"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Quantity fit",
            f"{quantity:g} kg vs {remaining_need:g} kg remaining need",
            raw_quantity,
            w["quantity"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Timing slack",
            f"{slack:.0f} min slack after travel and buffer",
            raw_timing,
            w["timing"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Recipient need",
            f"Need level {need_level} of 3",
            raw_need,
            w["need"],
        ),
    ]
    entry["breakdown"] = breakdown
    entry["score"] = round(
        raw_distance + raw_quantity + raw_timing + raw_need, 1
    )
    return entry


def _evaluate_volunteer(volunteer, listing, donor, now, pickup, minutes_left):
    quantity = float(listing["quantity_kg"] or 0.0)
    capacity = float(volunteer["carrying_capacity_kg"] or 0.0)

    distance = road_km(
        donor["lat"], donor["lng"], volunteer["lat"], volunteer["lng"]
    )
    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
    collection = now + timedelta(minutes=travel)
    collection_end = collection + timedelta(minutes=PICKUP_BUFFER_MIN)
    collection_hhmm = collection.astimezone(IST).strftime("%H:%M")
    now_ist = now.astimezone(IST)
    start_hhmm = now_ist.strftime("%H:%M")
    start_minutes = now_ist.hour * 60 + now_ist.minute
    end_ist = collection_end.astimezone(IST)
    end_hhmm = end_ist.strftime("%H:%M")
    end_minutes = end_ist.hour * 60 + end_ist.minute
    slack = (pickup - collection_end).total_seconds() / 60.0

    reasons = []
    if quantity > capacity:
        reasons.append(
            f"Carrying capacity {capacity:g} kg is below {quantity:g} kg."
        )

    from_text = volunteer["available_from_ist"]
    until_text = volunteer["available_until_ist"]
    from_min = parse_hhmm(from_text)
    until_min = parse_hhmm(until_text)
    if from_min is None or until_min is None:
        reasons.append("Availability window not recorded.")
    elif not (from_min <= start_minutes and end_minutes <= until_min):
        reasons.append(
            "Not available for the planned travel and collection period "
            f"{start_hhmm}-{end_hhmm} IST "
            f"(window {from_text.strip()}-{until_text.strip()} IST)."
        )

    if slack < 0:
        reasons.append(
            f"Cannot reach the donor before pickup-by (about {travel:.0f} min "
            "travel)."
        )

    entry = {
        "volunteer_id": volunteer["id"],
        "name": volunteer["name"],
        "eligible": not reasons,
        "score": None,
        "distance_km": round(distance, 1),
        "travel_min": round(travel, 1),
        "collection_time_ist": collection_hhmm,
        "breakdown": [],
        "reasons": reasons,
    }
    if reasons:
        return entry

    w = VOLUNTEER_WEIGHTS
    capacity_ratio = min(1.0, quantity / capacity) if capacity > 0 else 0.0
    raw_distance = w["distance"] * max(0.0, 1 - distance / MAX_DISTANCE_KM)
    raw_capacity = w["capacity"] * capacity_ratio
    raw_timing = w["timing"] * min(slack, TIMING_CAP_MIN) / TIMING_CAP_MIN

    entry["breakdown"] = [
        _breakdown_item(
            "Distance",
            f"{distance:.1f} km to donor (approx. road)",
            raw_distance,
            w["distance"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Capacity use",
            f"{quantity:g} of {capacity:g} kg carrying capacity",
            raw_capacity,
            w["capacity"],
        ),
        _breakdown_item(
            "Timing slack",
            f"{slack:.0f} min before pickup-by at collection",
            raw_timing,
            w["timing"],
        ),
    ]
    entry["score"] = round(raw_distance + raw_capacity + raw_timing, 1)
    return entry


def evaluate_listing(db, listing_id, now):
    """Evaluate every NGO and volunteer against one listing.

    Returns None if the listing does not exist. Otherwise returns a dict with
    listing_id, listing_open, listing_reason, receivers, volunteers and
    assumptions. Receivers and volunteers are empty when the listing is not
    open for matching.
    """
    listing = db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM listing WHERE id = ?", (listing_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if listing is None:
        return None

    pickup = parse_utc(listing["pickup_by_utc"])
    minutes_left = (pickup - now).total_seconds() / 60.0

    listing_open = True
    listing_reason = None
    if listing["status"] != "posted":
        listing_open = False
        listing_reason = (
            f"Listing is {listing['status']}, not open for matching."
        )
    elif pickup <= now:
        listing_open = False
        listing_reason = "Pickup-by deadline has passed."

    result = {
        "listing_id": listing_id,
        "listing_open": listing_open,
        "listing_reason": listing_reason,
        "receivers": [],
        "volunteers": [],
        "assumptions": list(ASSUMPTIONS),
    }
    if not listing_open:
        return result

    donor = db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM organisation WHERE id = ?",
        (listing["donor_org_id"],),
    ).fetchone()

    receivers = []
    for org in db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM organisation WHERE org_type = 'ngo' ORDER BY id"
    ).fetchall():
        receivers.append(
            _evaluate_receiver(db, listing, donor, org, now, minutes_left)
        )

    volunteers = []
    for volunteer in db.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM volunteer ORDER BY id"
    ).fetchall():
        volunteers.append(
            _evaluate_volunteer(
                volunteer, listing, donor, now, pickup, minutes_left
            )
        )

    result["receivers"] = _rank(receivers, "org_id")
    result["volunteers"] = _rank(volunteers, "volunteer_id")
    return result


@matching_bp.route("/listings/<int:listing_id>/matches")
def listing_matches(listing_id):
    db = get_db()
    result = evaluate_listing(db, listing_id, now_utc())
    if result is None:
        abort(404)
    listing = db.execute(
        "SELECT l.*, o.name AS donor_name FROM listing l "
        "JOIN organisation o ON o.id = l.donor_org_id WHERE l.id = ?",
        (listing_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    return render_template("matches.html", result=result, listing=listing)

import os

import click

def create_app(test_config=None):
    test_config = test_config or {}
    app = Flask(__name__)

    env_secret = os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY")
    if "SECRET_KEY" in test_config:
        secret = test_config["SECRET_KEY"]
    elif env_secret:
        secret = env_secret
    elif os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_ENV") == "production":
        raise RuntimeError("SURPLUSLINK_SECRET_KEY must be set when SURPLUSLINK_ENV=production")
    else:
        secret = DEV_SECRET_KEY

    default_db = PROJECT_ROOT / "instance" / "surpluslink.db"
    app.config.from_mapping(
        SECRET_KEY=secret,
        DATABASE=os.environ.get("SURPLUSLINK_DB_PATH", str(default_db)),
    )
    app.config.from_mapping(test_config)

    app.teardown_appcontext(db.close_db)
    app.register_blueprint(views.bp)
    app.register_blueprint(donations_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(matching_bp)
    app.add_template_filter(timeutils.format_ist, "ist")

        """Create the database tables if they do not exist. Keeps existing data."""
        db.init_db()

    @click.option("--reset", is_flag=True, help="Delete synthetic rows only, then seed again.")

        """Insert synthetic demo data (idempotent unless --reset)."""

            f"volunteers={result['volunteers']} personas={result['personas']} "
            f"listings={result['listings']}"
        )

    return app

"""M1 donation form: validation, persistence, donor-only posting, detail page."""

import math
import zoneinfo
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from flask import Blueprint, abort, redirect, render_template, request, url_for
from werkzeug.datastructures import MultiDict

from . import timeutils
from .db import get_db
from .views import current_persona

donations_bp = Blueprint("donations", __name__)

STORAGE_TYPES = ("ambient", "chilled", "frozen")
STORAGE_LABELS = {
    "ambient": "Ambient (dry goods, room temperature)",
    "chilled": "Chilled (refrigerated)",
    "frozen": "Frozen",
}
ALLERGENS = ("gluten", "dairy", "eggs", "nuts", "soy", "fish", "shellfish", "sesame")
MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN = 200
MAX_NOTES_LEN = 500
MIN_QUANTITY_KG = 0.1
MAX_QUANTITY_KG = 1000.0
DEADLINE_FORMAT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M"
IST = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("Asia/Kolkata")

QUANTITY_MESSAGE = f"Enter a quantity between {MIN_QUANTITY_KG:g} and {MAX_QUANTITY_KG:g} kg."


def validate_listing_form(form, now):
    """Validate submitted listing fields. Returns (cleaned, errors)."""
    cleaned = {}
    errors = {}

    description = form.get("description", "").strip()
    if not description:
        errors["description"] = "Enter a description of the food."
    elif len(description) > MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN:
        errors["description"] = f"Description must be {MAX_DESCRIPTION_LEN} characters or fewer."
    cleaned["description"] = description

    raw_quantity = form.get("quantity_kg", "").strip()
    quantity = None
    if not raw_quantity:
        errors["quantity_kg"] = QUANTITY_MESSAGE
    else:
        try:
            quantity = float(raw_quantity)
        except ValueError:
            quantity = None
        if quantity is None or not math.isfinite(quantity) or not (
            MIN_QUANTITY_KG <= quantity <= MAX_QUANTITY_KG
        ):
            errors["quantity_kg"] = QUANTITY_MESSAGE
    cleaned["quantity_kg"] = quantity

    raw_deadline = form.get("pickup_by", "").strip()
    cleaned["pickup_by_utc"] = None
    if not raw_deadline:
        errors["pickup_by"] = "Enter the pickup-by deadline."
    else:
        try:
            local = datetime.strptime(raw_deadline, DEADLINE_FORMAT).replace(tzinfo=IST)
        except ValueError:
            errors["pickup_by"] = "Enter a valid pickup-by date and time."
        else:
            if local <= now:
                errors["pickup_by"] = "Pickup-by must be in the future."
            else:
                cleaned["pickup_by_utc"] = timeutils.to_utc_iso(local)

    storage_type = form.get("storage_type", "").strip()
    if storage_type not in STORAGE_TYPES:
        errors["storage_type"] = "Choose a storage type."
    cleaned["storage_type"] = storage_type

    handling_notes = form.get("handling_notes", "").strip()
    if len(handling_notes) > MAX_NOTES_LEN:
        errors["handling_notes"] = f"Handling information must be {MAX_NOTES_LEN} characters or fewer."
    cleaned["handling_notes"] = handling_notes

    submitted = form.getlist("allergens")
    if any(a not in ALLERGENS for a in submitted):
        errors["allergens"] = "Choose allergens from the list."
    cleaned["allergens"] = ",".join(a for a in ALLERGENS if a in submitted)

    return cleaned, errors


def create_listing(db, donor_org_id, persona_id, cleaned, now):
    """Insert a posted listing and its first status event in one transaction."""
    stamp = timeutils.to_utc_iso(now)
    try:
        cursor = db.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO listing (donor_org_id, description, quantity_kg, pickup_by_utc,
                                 storage_type, handling_notes, allergens, status,
                                 created_at_utc, updated_at_utc)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'posted', ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                donor_org_id,
                cleaned["description"],
                cleaned["quantity_kg"],
                cleaned["pickup_by_utc"],
                cleaned["storage_type"],
                cleaned["handling_notes"],
                cleaned["allergens"],
                stamp,
                stamp,
            ),
        )
        listing_id = cursor.lastrowid
        db.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO status_event (listing_id, from_status, to_status, actor_persona_id, at_utc)
            VALUES (?, NULL, 'posted', ?, ?)
            """,
            (listing_id, persona_id, stamp),
        )
        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    return listing_id


def get_listing(db, listing_id):
    """Return the listing row joined with its donor organisation name, or None."""
    return db.execute(
        """
        SELECT l.*, o.name AS donor_name
        FROM listing l
        JOIN organisation o ON o.id = l.donor_org_id
        WHERE l.id = ?
        """,
        (listing_id,),
    ).fetchone()


def _require_donor():
    """Return (persona, None) for a donor; otherwise (None, response) or abort(403)."""
    persona = current_persona()
    if persona is None:
        return None, redirect(url_for("main.home"))
    if persona["role"] != "donor":
        abort(403)
    return persona, None


def _render_form(values, errors, status):
    return (
        render_template(
            "donate.html",
            values=values,
            errors=errors,
            storage_options=[(key, STORAGE_LABELS[key]) for key in STORAGE_TYPES],
            allergen_options=ALLERGENS,
        ),
        status,
    )


@donations_bp.route("/donate", methods=["GET", "POST"])
def new_listing():
    persona, response = _require_donor()
    if response is not None:
        return response

    if request.method == "GET":
        return _render_form(MultiDict(), {}, 200)

    now = timeutils.now_utc()
    cleaned, errors = validate_listing_form(request.form, now)
    if errors:
        return _render_form(request.form, errors, 400)

    db = get_db()
    row = db.execute("SELECT organisation_id FROM persona WHERE id = ?", (persona["id"],)).fetchone()
    listing_id = create_listing(db, row["organisation_id"], persona["id"], cleaned, now)
    return redirect(url_for("donations.listing_detail", listing_id=listing_id, created=1), code=303)


@donations_bp.route("/listings/<int:listing_id>")
def listing_detail(listing_id):
    listing = get_listing(get_db(), listing_id)
    if listing is None:
        abort(404)
    allergen_list = [a for a in (listing["allergens"] or "").split(",") if a]
    return render_template(
        "listing.html",
        listing=listing,
        allergen_list=allergen_list,
        show_created=request.args.get("created") == "1",
    )

"""M3 tests: receiver claiming, concurrency, capacity, rollback and routes."""

import html
import sqlite3
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from surplus_link import claiming
from surplus_link.claiming import attempt_claim, get_claimant, MESSAGES
from surplus_link.matching import check_receiver_eligibility, reserved_kg
from surplus_link.timeutils import set_clock
from surplus_link.db import get_db


NOW = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 6, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
NOW_ISO = "2025-01-01T06:00:00+00:00"
PICKUP = "2025-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"
DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG = 12.9000, 77.6000


@pytest.fixture
def fixed_clock():
    set_clock(NOW)
    yield NOW
    set_clock(None)


def open_conn(app):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(app.config["DATABASE"], timeout=10)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

def insert_org(db, name, org_type, lat, lng, cap=None, need=None, level=None,
               storage="ambient,chilled,frozen", excl=""):
    if org_type == "ngo":
        cur = db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO organisation (name, org_type, lat, lng, weekly_intake_capacity_kg, "
            "current_need_kg, need_level, accepted_storage, allergen_exclusions) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (name, org_type, lat, lng, cap, need, level, storage, excl),
        )
    else:
        cur = db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO organisation (name, org_type, lat, lng) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
            (name, org_type, lat, lng),
        )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_persona(db, display_name, role, organisation_id=None, volunteer_id=None):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO persona (display_name, role, organisation_id, volunteer_id) "
        "VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
        (display_name, role, organisation_id, volunteer_id),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_listing(db, donor_id, qty, pickup_utc_iso, storage="chilled", allergens="",
                   status="posted"):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO listing (donor_id, quantity_kg, pickup_by_utc, storage, allergens, "
        "status, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (donor_id, qty, pickup_utc_iso, storage, allergens, status, NOW_ISO, NOW_ISO),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert_claim(db, listing_id, receiver_id, qty, status="active",
                 claimed_at_utc="2025-01-01T06:00:00+00:00"):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO claim (listing_id, receiver_org_id, quantity_kg, status, claimed_at_utc) "
        "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
        (listing_id, receiver_id, qty, status, claimed_at_utc),
    )
    db.commit()
    return cur.lastrowid


def make_donor(db):
    return insert_org(db, "Donor Kitchen", "donor", DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG)


def make_receiver(db, name, cap=100):
    org = insert_org(db, name, "ngo", DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG, cap, 100, 2)
    persona = insert_persona(db, name + " persona", "receiver", organisation_id=org)
    return org, persona


def listing_status(conn, listing_id):
    return conn.execute("SELECT status FROM listing WHERE id=?", (listing_id,)).fetchone()["status"]


def claims_for(conn, listing_id):
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM claim WHERE listing_id=?", (listing_id,)).fetchall()


def events_for(conn, listing_id):
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM status_event WHERE listing_id=?", (listing_id,)).fetchall()


def run_concurrent(app, jobs):
    """jobs: list of (listing_id, persona_id, org_id). Returns (results, errors)."""
    n = len(jobs)
    barrier = threading.Barrier(n)
    results = [None] * n
    errors = []

    def worker(i, listing_id, persona_id, org_id):
        conn = None
        try:
            conn = open_conn(app)
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
            results[i] = attempt_claim(conn, listing_id, persona_id, org_id, NOW)
        except Exception as exc:  # store, do not swallow silently
            errors.append(repr(exc))
        finally:
            if conn is not None:
                conn.close()

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(i,) + tuple(job))
        for i, job in enumerate(jobs)
    ]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join(timeout=30)
    return results, errors


def seed_routes(app):
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        donor = make_donor(db)
        rec_org, rec_p = make_receiver(db, "Receiver NGO", 100)
        other_org, other_p = make_receiver(db, "Other NGO", 100)
        donor_p = insert_persona(db, "Donor P", "donor", organisation_id=donor)
        vol_p = insert_persona(db, "Volunteer P", "volunteer")
        listing = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)
    return {
        "donor_org": donor, "rec_org": rec_org, "rec_p": rec_p,
        "other_org": other_org, "other_p": other_p,
        "donor_p": donor_p, "vol_p": vol_p, "listing": listing,
    }


# ------------------------------------------------- direct claim behaviour

@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_successful_claim_updates_listing_and_creates_claim(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Recv A")
    lid = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)

    result = attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)

    assert result["ok"] is True
    assert result["code"] is None
    assert result["claim_id"] is not None
    assert listing_status(db, lid) == "claimed"
    claims = claims_for(db, lid)
    assert len(claims) == 1
    assert claims[0]["status"] == "active"
    assert claims[0]["quantity_kg"] == 15
    assert claims[0]["receiver_org_id"] == org
    assert claims[0]["claimed_at_utc"] == NOW_ISO
    db.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_successful_claim_records_status_event(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Recv A")
    lid = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)

    attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)

    events = events_for(db, lid)
    assert len(events) == 1
    assert events[0]["from_status"] == "posted"
    assert events[0]["to_status"] == "claimed"
    assert events[0]["actor_persona_id"] == persona
    db.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_second_claim_by_other_receiver_is_taken(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org_a, p_a = make_receiver(db, "Recv A")
    org_b, p_b = make_receiver(db, "Recv B")
    lid = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)

    first = attempt_claim(db, lid, p_a, org_a, NOW)
    second = attempt_claim(db, lid, p_b, org_b, NOW)

    assert first["ok"] is True
    assert second["ok"] is False
    assert second["code"] == "taken"
    assert "taken" in MESSAGES and MESSAGES["taken"]
    assert len(claims_for(db, lid)) == 1
    db.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_same_receiver_second_claim_is_duplicate(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Recv A")
    lid = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)

    first = attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)
    again = attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)

    assert first["ok"] is True
    assert again["ok"] is False
    assert again["code"] == "duplicate"
    assert len(claims_for(db, lid)) == 1
    assert listing_status(db, lid) == "claimed"
    db.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_concurrent_claims_on_one_listing(app):
    setup = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(setup)
    lid = insert_listing(setup, donor, 15, PICKUP)
    receivers = [make_receiver(setup, f"Recv {i}") for i in range(6)]
    jobs = [(lid, persona, org) for org, persona in receivers]

    results, errors = run_concurrent(app, jobs)

    assert errors == []
    assert all(r is not None for r in results)
    oks = [r for r in results if r["ok"]]
    assert len(oks) == 1
    for r in results:
        if not r["ok"]:
            assert r["code"] == "taken"
    assert len(claims_for(setup, lid)) == 1
    assert listing_status(setup, lid) == "claimed"
    events = events_for(setup, lid)
    assert len(events) == 1
    assert events[0]["from_status"] == "posted"
    assert events[0]["to_status"] == "claimed"
    setup.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_claim_closed_after_deadline(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Recv A")
    lid = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, "2025-01-01T05:00:00+00:00")

    result = attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)

    assert result["ok"] is False
    assert result["code"] == "closed"
    assert claims_for(db, lid) == []
    assert listing_status(db, lid) == "posted"

@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_capacity_competition_only_one_listing_fits(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Small NGO", cap=20)
    l1 = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)
    l2 = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)

    first = attempt_claim(db, l1, persona, org, NOW)
    second = attempt_claim(db, l2, persona, org, NOW)

    assert first["ok"] is True
    assert second["ok"] is False
    assert second["code"] == "ineligible"
    active = db.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(quantity_kg),0) AS kg FROM claim "
        "WHERE receiver_org_id=? AND status='active'", (org,)
    ).fetchone()
    assert active["n"] == 1
    assert active["kg"] == 15
    active_kg, _ = reserved_kg(db, org, NOW)
    assert active_kg == 15
    db.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_concurrent_listings_competing_for_capacity(app):
    setup = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(setup)
    org = insert_org(setup, "Small NGO", "ngo", DONOR_LAT, DONOR_LNG, 20, 100, 2)
    p1 = insert_persona(setup, "Small P1", "receiver", organisation_id=org)
    p2 = insert_persona(setup, "Small P2", "receiver", organisation_id=org)
    l1 = insert_listing(setup, donor, 15, PICKUP)
    l2 = insert_listing(setup, donor, 15, PICKUP)

    results, errors = run_concurrent(app, [(l1, p1, org), (l2, p2, org)])

    assert errors == []
    oks = [r for r in results if r["ok"]]
    fails = [r for r in results if not r["ok"]]
    assert len(oks) == 1
    assert len(fails) == 1
    assert fails[0]["code"] == "ineligible"
    total = setup.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_kg),0) AS kg FROM claim "
        "WHERE receiver_org_id=? AND status='active'", (org,)
    ).fetchone()["kg"]
    assert total == 15
    statuses = {listing_status(setup, l1), listing_status(setup, l2)}
    assert statuses == {"claimed", "posted"}
    setup.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_released_claim_frees_capacity(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Small NGO", cap=20)
    other_listing = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP, status="claimed")
    released_claim = insert_claim(db, other_listing, org, 15, status="active")
    lid = insert_listing(db, donor, 10, PICKUP)

    blocked = attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)
    assert blocked["ok"] is False
    assert blocked["code"] == "ineligible"

    db.execute("UPDATE claim SET status='released' WHERE id=?", (released_claim,))
    db.commit()

    entry = check_receiver_eligibility(db, lid, org, NOW)
    assert entry is not None and entry["eligible"] is True

    result = attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)
    assert result["ok"] is True
    assert listing_status(db, lid) == "claimed"
    db.close()


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_active_claim_from_old_date_still_reserves(app):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Small NGO", cap=20)

    result = attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)

    assert result["ok"] is False
    assert result["code"] == "ineligible"

@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fixed_clock")
def test_rollback_on_status_event_failure(app, monkeypatch):
    db = open_conn(app)
    donor = make_donor(db)
    org, persona = make_receiver(db, "Recv A")
    lid = insert_listing(db, donor, 15, PICKUP)

    def boom(*args, **kwargs):
        raise sqlite3.OperationalError("boom")

    monkeypatch.setattr(claiming, "_insert_status_event", boom)
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.OperationalError):
        attempt_claim(db, lid, persona, org, NOW)
    db.close()

    check = open_conn(app)
    assert listing_status(check, lid) == "posted"
    assert claims_for(check, lid) == []
    assert events_for(check, lid) == []
    check.close()
