"""Public donation board: read-only browse of open, unexpired donations.

Anyone can browse. Claiming stays in claiming.py and is enforced there.
This module never expires listings and never writes to the database.
"""

from flask import Blueprint, render_template, request

from .db import get_db
from .donations import STORAGE_LABELS
from .timeutils import format_ist, now_utc, parse_utc
from .views import current_persona

board_bp = Blueprint("board", __name__)

STORAGE_VALUES = ("ambient", "chilled", "frozen")
STORAGE_OPTIONS = [
    ("", "All storage"),
    ("ambient", "Ambient"),
    ("chilled", "Chilled"),
    ("frozen", "Frozen"),
]
MAX_QUERY_LEN = 100

_OPEN_SQL = """
    SELECT l.id, l.description, l.quantity_kg, l.storage_type, l.allergens,
           l.pickup_by_utc, o.name AS donor_name
    FROM listing l
    JOIN organisation o ON o.id = l.donor_org_id
    WHERE l.status = 'posted'
    ORDER BY l.pickup_by_utc ASC, l.id ASC
"""


def available_listings(db, now, q="", storage="", sort="deadline"):
    """Return open, unexpired listings as display dicts, soonest pickup deadline first.

    Only "deadline" sorting is supported; any other sort value is treated as "deadline"
    (the SQL already orders by deadline).
    """
    needle = (q or "").strip().lower()
    results = []
    for row in db.execute(_OPEN_SQL).fetchall():
        if parse_utc(row["pickup_by_utc"]) <= now:
            continue
        if storage in STORAGE_VALUES and row["storage_type"] != storage:
            continue
        if needle:
            haystack = (
                row["description"].lower(),
                row["donor_name"].lower(),
                (row["allergens"] or "").lower(),
            )
            if not any(needle in text for text in haystack):
                continue
        storage_type = row["storage_type"]
        results.append(
            {
                "id": row["id"],
                "description": row["description"],
                "quantity_kg": row["quantity_kg"],
                "storage_type": storage_type,
                "storage_label": STORAGE_LABELS.get(storage_type, (storage_type or "").capitalize()),
                "allergens": [a.strip() for a in (row["allergens"] or "").split(",") if a.strip()],
                "donor_name": row["donor_name"],
                "pickup_by_ist": format_ist(row["pickup_by_utc"]),
                "pickup_by_utc": row["pickup_by_utc"],
            }
        )
    return results


@board_bp.route("/board")
def board_view():
    q = request.args.get("q", "").strip()[:MAX_QUERY_LEN]
    storage = request.args.get("storage", "")
    if storage not in STORAGE_VALUES:
        storage = ""

    db = get_db()
    now = now_utc()
    items = available_listings(db, now, q, storage)
    total_open = len(available_listings(db, now, "", ""))

    persona = current_persona()
    viewer_role = persona["role"] if persona is not None else None

    return render_template(
        "board.html",
        items=items,
        q=q,
        storage=storage,
        storage_options=STORAGE_OPTIONS,
        total_open=total_open,
        is_filtered=bool(q or storage),
        viewer_role=viewer_role,
    )

--- surpluslink\surplus_link\schema.sql ---
-- SurplusLink schema (SQLite). Synthetic data only.
--
-- DOCUMENTATION OF CAPACITY RULES (logic is NOT implemented in M0):
--   * organisation.weekly_intake_capacity_kg = maximum kg a receiver (NGO) can take in a week.
--   * organisation.current_need_kg           = kg the NGO currently wants.
--   * An active claim (claim.status = 'active') reserves kg from the receiver's
--     remaining weekly capacity.
--   * A claim is 'released' when it is cancelled, or when its listing expires.
--   * Delivered / completed claims consume the receiver's capacity for the week.
--
-- Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 text (e.g. 2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00).
-- Volunteer availability times are IST text (HH:MM).
-- Every table here is created with IF NOT EXISTS; nothing is ever dropped by init.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organisation (
    id                        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name                      TEXT NOT NULL,
    org_type                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (org_type IN ('donor', 'ngo')),
    zone                      TEXT NOT NULL,
    lat                       REAL NOT NULL,
    lng                       REAL NOT NULL,
    weekly_intake_capacity_kg REAL,
    current_need_kg           REAL,
    need_level                INTEGER CHECK (need_level BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    accepted_storage          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    allergen_exclusions       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    open_hours                TEXT,
    is_synthetic              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS volunteer (
    id                   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    zone                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    lat                  REAL NOT NULL,
    lng                  REAL NOT NULL,
    carrying_capacity_kg REAL NOT NULL CHECK (carrying_capacity_kg > 0),
    available_from_ist   TEXT NOT NULL,
    available_until_ist  TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_synthetic         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS persona (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name    TEXT NOT NULL,
    role            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('donor', 'receiver', 'volunteer')),
    organisation_id INTEGER REFERENCES organisation(id),
    volunteer_id    INTEGER REFERENCES volunteer(id),
    CHECK (
        (role IN ('donor', 'receiver') AND organisation_id IS NOT NULL AND volunteer_id IS NULL)
        OR
        (role = 'volunteer' AND volunteer_id IS NOT NULL AND organisation_id IS NULL)
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS listing (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    donor_org_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES organisation(id),
    description     TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity_kg     REAL NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_kg > 0),
    pickup_by_utc   TEXT NOT NULL,
    storage_type    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (storage_type IN ('ambient', 'chilled', 'frozen')),
    handling_notes  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    allergens       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('posted', 'claimed', 'collected', 'delivered', 'expired', 'cancelled')),
    created_at_utc  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at_utc  TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS claim (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id       INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES listing(id),
    receiver_org_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES organisation(id),
    volunteer_id     INTEGER REFERENCES volunteer(id),
    quantity_kg      REAL NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_kg > 0),
    status           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'released', 'completed')),
    claimed_at_utc   TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS status_event (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    listing_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES listing(id),
    from_status      TEXT,
    to_status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_persona_id INTEGER REFERENCES persona(id),
    at_utc           TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listing_status ON listing(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_claim_receiver_status ON claim(receiver_org_id, status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_status_event_listing ON status_event(listing_id);

         need=100.0, level=2, storage="ambient,chilled,frozen", excl=""):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO organisation (name, org_type, zone, lat, lng, weekly_intake_capacity_kg, "
        "current_need_kg, need_level, accepted_storage, allergen_exclusions) "
        "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (name, org_type, zone, lat, lng, cap, need, level, storage, excl),
    )
    return cur.lastrowid


def _listing(db, donor_id, description, qty, storage, status="posted",
             pickup=FUTURE, allergens=""):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO listing (donor_org_id, description, quantity_kg, pickup_by_utc, storage_type, "
        "handling_notes, allergens, status, created_at_utc, updated_at_utc) "
        "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (donor_id, description, qty, pickup, storage, "", allergens, status,
         "2025-01-01T06:00:00+00:00", "2025-01-01T06:00:00+00:00"),
    )
    return cur.lastrowid


def _volunteer(db):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO volunteer (name, zone, lat, lng, carrying_capacity_kg, "
        "available_from_ist, available_until_ist) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        ("Vol", "Zone A", 12.9, 77.6, 50.0, "00:00", "23:59"),
    )
    return cur.lastrowid


def _persona(db, display_name, role, organisation_id=None, volunteer_id=None):
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO persona (display_name, role, organisation_id, volunteer_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
        (display_name, role, organisation_id, volunteer_id),
    )
    return cur.lastrowid

import os, sqlite3, time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5019"
TEMP = os.environ["TEMP"]
DB = os.path.join(TEMP, "surplus_cp3.db")
console_msgs, failed, bad_status = [], [], []

def attach(page, label):
    page.on("console", lambda m: console_msgs.append(f"{label} {m.type}: {m.text}") if m.type in ("error", "warning") else None)
    page.on("pageerror", lambda e: console_msgs.append(f"{label} pageerror: {e}"))
    page.on("requestfailed", lambda r: failed.append(f"{label} FAILED {r.url} {r.failure}"))
    page.on("response", lambda r: bad_status.append(f"{label} {r.status} {r.url}") if r.status >= 400 else None)

def db_status(status):
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c.execute("update listing set status=?", (status,))
    c.commit()
    c.close()

JS_OVERFLOW = """() => {
  const vw = window.innerWidth; const wide = [];
  for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('body *')) {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width > 0 && r.right > vw + 0.5) {
      wide.push(el.tagName.toLowerCase() + (typeof el.className === 'string' && el.className ? '.' + el.className.trim().split(/\\s+/).join('.') : '') + ' right=' + Math.round(r.right) + ' text=' + (el.innerText || '').trim().slice(0, 40));
      if (wide.length >= 5) break;
    }
  }
  return {innerWidth: vw, scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, wide: wide};
}"""

JS_FOCUS = """() => {
  const e = document.activeElement; const cs = getComputedStyle(e); const r = e.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {tag: e.tagName.toLowerCase(), id: e.id, type: e.type || '',
          text: (e.innerText || e.value || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().slice(0, 40),
          href: e.getAttribute('href') || '', outlineStyle: cs.outlineStyle, outlineWidth: cs.outlineWidth,
          outlineColor: cs.outlineColor, height: Math.round(r.height * 10) / 10};
}"""

JS_TOUCH = """() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button,input,select')).filter(e => {
  const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs = getComputedStyle(e);
  return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && r.height < 44; }).map(e => ({
  tag: e.tagName.toLowerCase(), type: e.type || '', id: e.id,
  text: (e.innerText || e.value || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.name || '').trim().slice(0, 40),
  height: Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().height * 10) / 10}))"""

JS_FORM = """() => {
  const q = document.querySelector('#q'); const f = q ? q.form : null;
  const controls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('form input, form select, form button')).map(e => {
    const r = e.getBoundingClientRect();
    return [e.tagName.toLowerCase(), e.id || e.name || e.textContent.trim().slice(0, 20), Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.top), Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; });
  return {formDisplay: f ? getComputedStyle(f).display : null,
          formGridCols: f ? getComputedStyle(f).gridTemplateColumns : null,
          controls: controls};
}"""

def submit(page):
    with page.expect_navigation(wait_until="load"):
        page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('#q').form.requestSubmit()")
    time.sleep(1)

def set_storage(page, value):
    sels = page.locator("form select")
    for i in range(sels.count()):
        opts = sels.nth(i).evaluate("s => Array.from(s.options).map(o => ({v: o.value, t: o.textContent.trim()}))")
        if any(o["v"].lower() == "frozen" or o["t"].lower() == "frozen" for o in opts):
            match = [o["v"] for o in opts if o["v"].lower() == value or o["t"].lower() == value]
            sels.nth(i).select_option(value=match[0])
            return ("set storage select #%d to value=%r opts=%r" % (i, match[0], opts))
    return "NO STORAGE SELECT FOUND"

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)

    print("=== STEP 3 overflow/heading")
    for w, h, scale, label, shot in [(375, 812, 2, "m375", "cp3_board_375.png"), (1280, 800, 1, "d1280", "cp3_board_1280.png")]:
        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": w, "height": h}, device_scale_factor=scale)
        page = ctx.new_page(); attach(page, label)
        resp = page.goto(BASE + "/board", wait_until="load"); time.sleep(1)
        info = page.evaluate(JS_OVERFLOW)
        h1 = page.locator("h1").all_inner_texts()
        body = page.inner_text("body").lower()
        print(label, "HTTP", resp.status, "url", page.url, "overflow", info)
        print(label, "h1", h1, "h2.listing-title count", page.locator("h2.listing-title").count(),
              "titles", page.locator("h2.listing-title").all_inner_texts(),
              "soonest phrase present", "soonest pickup deadline first" in body)
        path = os.path.join(TEMP, shot)
        page.screenshot(path=path, full_page=True)
        print(label, "screenshot", path)
        ctx.close()

    print("=== STEP 4 filters")
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800})
    page = ctx.new_page(); attach(page, "filters")
    page.goto(BASE + "/board", wait_until="load"); time.sleep(1)
    print("form controls", page.evaluate(JS_FORM)["controls"])
    page.fill("#q", "peas"); submit(page)
    print("q=peas url", page.url, "count", page.locator("h2.listing-title").count(), "titles", page.locator("h2.listing-title").all_inner_texts())
    page.fill("#q", "")
    print(set_storage(page, "frozen")); submit(page)
    print("storage=frozen url", page.url, "count", page.locator("h2.listing-title").count(), "titles", page.locator("h2.listing-title").all_inner_texts())
    page.fill("#q", "zzz")
    print(set_storage(page, ""))
    submit(page)
    body = page.inner_text("body")
    print("q=zzz url", page.url, "count", page.locator("h2.listing-title").count(),
          "no-match text", "No donations match these filters." in body,
          "Reset filters matches", page.get_by_text("Reset filters").count(),
          "Reset tag", page.get_by_text("Reset filters").first.evaluate("e => e.tagName") if page.get_by_text("Reset filters").count() else None)
    if page.get_by_text("Reset filters").count():
        with page.expect_navigation(wait_until="load"):
            page.get_by_text("Reset filters").first.click()
        time.sleep(1)
    print("after Reset filters url", page.url, "count", page.locator("h2.listing-title").count())

    print("=== STEP 5 empty state")
    db_status("cancelled")
    page.goto(BASE + "/board", wait_until="load"); time.sleep(1)
    body = page.inner_text("body")
    print("all cancelled: 'No open donations right now.' present", "No open donations right now." in body, "count", page.locator("h2.listing-title").count())
    db_status("posted")
    page.goto(BASE + "/board", wait_until="load"); time.sleep(1)
    print("restored posted: count", page.locator("h2.listing-title").count())
    ctx.close()

    print("=== STEP 6 keyboard at 375")
    ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 375, "height": 812})
    page = ctx.new_page(); attach(page, "kbd")
    page.goto(BASE + "/board", wait_until="load"); time.sleep(1)
    seq = []
    reached_q = False
    for i in range(40):
        page.keyboard.press("Tab"); time.sleep(0.15)
        f = page.evaluate(JS_FOCUS); seq.append(f)
        if f["id"] == "q":
            reached_q = True; break
    print("reached #q:", reached_q, "after presses", len(seq))
    for i in range(20):
        if reached_q and seq and seq[-1]["tag"] == "a" and "view details" in seq[-1]["text"].lower():
            break
        page.keyboard.press("Tab"); time.sleep(0.15)
        seq.append(page.evaluate(JS_FOCUS))
    for s in seq:
        print("focus", s)
    ctx.close()

    print("=== STEP 7 touch targets and form layout")
    for w, h, label in [(375, 812, "m375"), (1280, 800, "d1280")]:
        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": w, "height": h})
        page = ctx.new_page(); attach(page, "touch" + label)
        page.goto(BASE + "/board", wait_until="load"); time.sleep(1)
        print(label, "under-44px targets", page.evaluate(JS_TOUCH))
        print(label, "form layout", page.evaluate(JS_FORM))
        ctx.close()

    browser.close()

print("=== STEP 9 console/network")
print("console errors/warnings:", console_msgs)
print("requestfailed:", failed)
print("HTTP >=400 responses:", bad_status)
print("SCRIPT_DONE")
'@; "WROTE $script"
